data.description: In any condition of illumination other than bright light, the eidolon disappears into the shadows, giving it concealment (20%% miss chance). If it has the shadow form evolution, it instead gains total concealment (50%% miss chance). The eidolon can suspend or resume this ability as a free action.
data.name: Shadow Blend
